title: pilosella brachiata subsp. nigribractea
intro: Pilosella brachiata subsp. nigribractea, commonly known as Black-headed Hawkweed, is a plant species within the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella brachiata subsp. nigribractea are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses and exhibit antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the treatment of various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
